items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: So it just so happened that Art Holder was going to be down that way playing in Columbia, South Carolina and he was going to make a recording for George Buck. So he got Art

ctx.x: Buck who produced those first albums of Fat Cat. But now George Buck is doing his own thing. There seems to have been a split between the two of them. And I have some friends who live down in Southern Pines, North Carolina who used to be located up in Manchester, New Hampshire, and I used to go up to New Hampshire and do a private thing for them with guys like Herb Hall and Cheatham, Herman Autry Doc and those guys. So anyway, Joe Robertson is is name and he was to promote these concerts up there to raise funds…
